dynamic.semantics: Two dynamic probability clocks; operator/partition counts sampled, ordinary partitions nearuniform; rare_hot affects both INSERT/PROBE and bytes.

IID.semantics: Fixed bounded total partition-byte layout and allocated build tuple counts; shuffled INSERTs, then SWITCH barrier, then IID probe draws. This differs from R72 no-per-partition-count-quota contract.

model_boundary: Original R72 dynamic model unchanged. IID track independently preallocates build bytes/counts before shuffled INSERT, SWITCH barrier and IID PROBE; not the same count-sampling model.
scope: Frozen generator source/binary identity and documented interface only. No scheduler source or native strategy execution involved.
